name: Dragonfly Aviation
summary: Diamond and Cirrus flight school at Winder airport in Georgia with a pay-as-you-go rate sheet.
differentiator: Puts a membership price next to the hourly rate: $500 a year takes $15 off each single-engine hour, so the membership pays for itself after about 34 hours of flying.
pricing: Diamond DA20 at $155 an hour, DA40 at $220, instruction $60 to $100 an hour.

aircraft.label: Cirrus G6 SR20
aircraft.note: Listed as $275 with no per-hour label on the page.

feesNamed: Club program: $50 a month or $500 a year, saves $15 an hour on single-engine rentals and $20 an hour on multi-engine rentals
Multi-engine add-on package $6,000 (10 hours in a DA42, 1 hour in the simulator, ground instruction)
Simulator: $375 a year or $35 an hour
bestFor: Students who expect to fly often and want the lower member rate in a Diamond DA20.
skipIf: You want one instructor rate and a stated wet or dry basis.
watchOut: The Cirrus SR20 line shows $275 with no "per hour" label.
Instructor rates appear as ranges ($60 to $100) without saying what sets the rate.
The page does not say whether aircraft rates include fuel.
